name: سنوزر انمي
audience: Egyptian Arabic-speaking anime fans who enjoy romantic and comic story recaps with clear character continuity
dialect: Conversational Egyptian Arabic with natural comic timing
tone: Warm, lively, playful and character-led; jokes should clarify emotion or reversal rather than bury the plot
style: Original anime-inspired editorial panels with consistent character sheets, readable silhouettes and expressions, warm cinematic color, deliberate reaction close-ups, and a strong distinction between setup, reversal and payoff. Compose stills for purposeful cuts and occasional local layer reveals; add speech and labels only in the local compositor. Avoid screenshot imitation, drifting faces or outfits, generic speed lines, and a camera move on every image.
